name: metrordle
description: Metrordle - daily Mexico City Metro minigames. The site itself is static with no build step; this package only vendors the Firebase SDK into vendor/firebase/ so it loads same-origin (ad blockers block the gstatic.com CDN). See docs/firebase.md.

scripts.vendor:firebase: mkdir -p vendor/firebase && cp node_modules/firebase/firebase-app-compat.js node_modules/firebase/firebase-firestore-compat.js vendor/firebase/ && echo 'Vendored firebase-app-compat.js + firebase-firestore-compat.js into vendor/firebase/ - remember to bump CACHE_NAME in sw.js.'
